description: Airside/apron facade from the ramp, Dec 2010 (post-2009 HNTB expansion): two-story glazed departure lounge at right, low green metal roof with deep overhang on tapered concrete piers, continuous sloped gate canopies over hold-room windows; United CRJ, fuel truck, apron light poles for scale.
Close-up of landside main entry: green standing-seam gable roof with deep overhanging eaves, exposed glulam beams/purlins, green-tinted curtain-wall glazing, stone-masonry base, warm wood soffits.

Oblique aerial of landside (contractor portfolio): stepped/sawtooth green standing-seam gable and shed roofs, tan walls, stone accents, projecting entry canopies, glulam gable ends; curbside drop-off loop and parking in front.
Landside front elevation of the core building (2006, before the 2009 airside expansion): multiple low green metal gable roofs, curved projecting entry canopy over the curb, tan walls; low resolution.

Curbside/parking approach, June 2011: bronze eagle sculpture on reddish basalt stone plinth, freestanding dark ATC tower behind, right edge shows the terminal's projecting green entry canopy; roadway and lot layout.
USGS top-down orthophoto (2006) of the whole airport; terminal complex and apron on the west side, crossing-runway (X) layout, high-desert surroundings. Good for footprint/orientation.
Low-resolution oblique aerial of the airfield (Feb 2008) showing terminal, apron and ramps on the west side relative to the runways.
